headline: Speaker says he knows nothing about president's resignation
summary: National Parliament Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed denies knowledge of any plans for the president to step down after returning from Thailand.
details: National Parliament Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed stated that he is unaware of any plans regarding the resignation of the president.
The Speaker made these remarks on Friday afternoon at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport upon his return from Bangkok, Thailand, where he had gone for a medical check-up.
When questioned by journalists about the possibility of the president's resignation, he replied, 'I do not know what the president will or will not do. He is the first citizen of the country.'
The statement comes amid widespread rumors and speculation regarding the president's potential departure from Bangabhaban.
caption:
Does the president plan to resign? The Speaker says he doesn't know.

National Parliament Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed stated that he is unaware of any plans regarding the resignation of the president.

The Speaker made these remarks on Friday afternoon at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport upon his return from Bangkok, Thailand, where he had gone for a medical check-up.

When questioned by journalists about the possibility of the president's resignation, he replied, 'I do not know what the president will or will not do. He is the first citizen of the country.'

The statement comes amid widespread rumors and speculation regarding the president's potential departure from Bangabhaban.

headline: Tragedy in Tangail: MBSTU student dies after fall and electrocution
summary: Moniruzzaman Monir, a 22-year-old ICT student, passed away after coming into contact with a live electric line and falling from a hostel balcony.
details: Moniruzzaman Monir, a first-year second-semester student of the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Department at Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University (MBSTU), has died.

The incident occurred last night in the Arifnagar area near the campus. According to university proctor Prof Monir Morshed, the student came into contact with a live electric line and subsequently fell from the second-floor balcony of Khaja Hostel.
Fellow students rushed Monir to Tangail Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared him dead at approximately 11:45 pm.
A namaz-e-janaza was held at the university mosque today at 11:30 am before the body was handed over to his family.
MBSTU Vice-Chancellor Prof ABM Shahidul Islam expressed deep shock over the loss and prayed for the peace of the departed soul.
caption:
A 22-year-old MBSTU student has died after a tragic accident involving a live electric line and a fall from a hostel balcony.

Moniruzzaman Monir, a first-year second-semester student of the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Department at Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University (MBSTU), has died.

The incident occurred last night in the Arifnagar area near the campus. According to university proctor Prof Monir Morshed, the student came into contact with a live electric line and subsequently fell from the second-floor balcony of Khaja Hostel.

Fellow students rushed Monir to Tangail Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared him dead at approximately 11:45 pm.

A namaz-e-janaza was held at the university mosque today at 11:30 am before the body was handed over to his family.

MBSTU Vice-Chancellor Prof ABM Shahidul Islam expressed deep shock over the loss and prayed for the peace of the departed soul.
